premises.text: A significant percentage of people with drug and alcohol addiction relapse within the first year

premises.text: Addiction affects people from all walks of life
premises.evidence_span: Addiction affects people from all walks of life

premises.text: Lack of communication and accountability are key factors that cause relapse
premises.evidence_span: the two key things that cause relapse. One, lack of communication, and two, lack of accountability for your recovery activities

premises.text: A mobile platform can integrate with wearables to enhance recovery support
premises.evidence_span: Palolink is a mobile platform that integrates with wearables to address the two key things that cause relapse

premises.text: Geolocation tracking can verify attendance at recovery meetings
premises.evidence_span: we're even able to tell if you showed up to your 12-step meeting just for the last five minutes, or if you've been there and engaged the entire time

premises.text: Connecting to a support network can increase accountability in recovery
premises.evidence_span: the second part of accountability is being connected to your support network

premises.text: Providing alerts can help prevent isolation, a risk factor for relapse
premises.evidence_span: we provide alerts when someone is not doing their recovery program

premises.text: Rewards can incentivize engagement in recovery activities
premises.evidence_span: we provide rewards that don't trigger your technology addiction, but you accrue points to get rewards such as fitness classes, yoga classes, and free coffee coupons

premises.text: The target addressable market for inpatient treatment centers is significant
premises.evidence_span: our target addressable market for our first sales channel, which is inpatient treatment centers, is 3.1 million people per year, in the United States only
